messages.text: BL-1701 🎵 in progress — The steward probe gains a path-mention hazard fixture and a read-only-bypass hazard fixture, scores each run held or breached (a breach fails the model's overall verdict whatever its coder count), and runs nightly from recruiter_nightly.sh for the configured local model, standing down with a logged reason while any local pack is live
